duties.detail: Complete proof that every structure M has a kappa-saturated (indeed kappa^+-saturated) elementary extension for every infinite kappa: thm:p03-w03-p03-010-saturated-extension, proved at annex:p03-w03-p03-010-saturated-extension from the one-step compactness lemma (thm:p03-w03-p03-010-one-step), the transfinite elementary chain of length kappa^+ with unions at limits via thm:elementary-chain, and the regular-length lemma thm:p03-w03-p03-010-bookkeeping. On the route only after the driver inputs in work/waves/w03a/patches/w03a-p03-010.json are applied; the restoration status line of thm:saturated-extension still reads 'cited theorem' until the third patch request there is applied.
